description: MainActivity.java defines the main Android activity that manages UI interactions, service binding, and audio playback functionalities for a voice interaction app.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing UI, service connection, and audio playback within the voice interaction application.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI elements, sets click listeners, and checks for service connection.

methods.name: attachClickListener
methods.description: Sets click listener for buttons to trigger audio playback.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Binds to the voice interaction service.

methods.name: onServiceConnected
methods.description: Handles actions upon successful binding to the service.

methods.name: onServiceDisconnected
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the service is disconnected.

methods.name: playAudio
methods.description: Creates and plays an AudioTrack object from the provided byte array buffer.
